accepted: Homepage cold shell sets no-store and middleware replaces it with public max-age from _CACHE_PATHS. fly.toml:66 makes both HOMEPAGE_SHELL reads 60.
Price cache is an unlocked whole-file replace. Do not hold a lock across the outbound fetch. Negative-cache unavailable on a short TTL, do not stop caching it.
Snapshot late publish is real. Single-flight already refuses a second in-process build. Do not treat caller timeout as proof the build is invalid. No timeout increase.
write_soul_map returns the mutated blob after a swallowed persistence error. Cache is updated only after os.replace. Return the pre-mutation blob. Mutator exceptions are already outside the try.
corrections_to_auditor: _bust_cache_ttl exists at internal/council/price_reference.py:489 on this pin. SHA-256 of that line is 0a9ccfed8cd9d33eb9d9faba8aaa5ce28ce1b156fa110545bd008e49b26ab25c. It is not in price_fetcher.py. Lock-ordering still applies to that function.
sqlite3.connect default timeout is 5 seconds in CPython. L3-004's 'no timeout argument' is not 'no timeout'.

brothers.finding: Timeout bumps _work_generation and shutdown(wait=False). The generation check runs only after get_or_create_today_pick returns, so writes inside that call are not rolled back. stop_pick_schedulers nulls the scheduler objects. DailyPickScheduler.stop cancels the job and does not bump _work_generation.

append_prediction and save_predictions both take locked_predictions_file (fcntl.flock, 5s) before _write_predictions_unlocked os.replace. Callers in expired_recovery, ledger_heal, and expert_backfill use save_predictions. An unlocked os.replace race inside this module is not shown. A caller that loads, mutates, then save_predictions can still drop another writer's rows because the lock covers the write, not the caller's earlier read.
